ns2:course.label: Thesis/Adv UG Honors in Music
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 229) Special individual research projects. Required of seniors in the history of music and composition-theory curricula; open also to advanced undergraduates, including James Scholars, who have achieved university or college honors and who desire to do research in specialized areas of music, including performance. Counts for advanced hours in LAS. Prerequisite: Senior standing in the history of music or composition-theory curriculum, or consent of instructor.
